utc_note: Frozen before scripts/run_h71.py is executed. Thresholds below are not revised after seeing holdout numbers.
method_paragraph: Blind and poorly mapped permeable faults in the GeoDAWN / northwestern Great Basin are often expressed by colinear geothermal discharge — hot and warm springs, sinter and travertine, and shallow 2 m temperature anomalies — rather than by a USGS/INGENIOUS scarp. Fit a local principal axis to discharge points inside a 6 km neighbourhood; keep the axis only when it is elongated, has at least three points spanning 1.5 km, has perpendicular RMS under 350 m, and contains at least one non-well anchor (spring, sinter/travertine/alteration, 2 m anomaly, vent, or a geothermometer >= 120 C). Rasterize that axis. Experiment 2 keeps axis pixels only where the upward-continued magnetic horizontal gradient is in the top 40 percent of the footprint. Experiment 3 extends those corroborated axes along strike by up to 4 km while the gradient stays elevated. Emit a 3 px Euclidean NMS of the trace, at most 12000 dots, with catalogue pixels set to zero. Do not use dist_known_fault_px or any other label-derived distance column. Exclude tufa and silica-cemented sand from seeds because Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shorelines (highstand near 1332-1338 m) precipitate tufa that is not a fault.
why_not_the_catalogue: The USGS/INGENIOUS compilation records faults with geomorphic or mapped expression. A discharge alignment under basin fill can mark a permeable conduit that compilation missed. The detector is seeded by discharge points, not by dilating the catalogue.
differs_from_repo: Not a dotted habitat thinning of H19-5 (the 0.2600-0.2778 family), not lidar scarplet/Steger/Frangi, not chi/knickpoint, not relay-ramp geometry from catalogue tips, not auto-context, not CVaR selection of an existing field, not the E62 thermal multiplier on knickpoints.
named_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan tufa shoreline, and cultural alignments of water wells along roads
experiments: E2 axes gated by TMI-up150 horizontal-gradient percentile
E3 E2 axes extended along strike while the gradient stays elevated

promote_requires: canary AUC of every used feature <= 0.90
like-for-like uniqueness pass on the surface before placement and on the final dots (Spearman <= 0.90 against every checked raster; forward 3 px overlap <= 0.70 against dot-field rasters)
HOLDOUT-DTI paired difference versus mass-matched NMS random has 95% CI lower bound > 0 on gems57-pooled-hide-v2
HOLDOUT-DTI point estimate exceeds every local registry raster rescored on the same folds
gates.literal_overlap_against_space_filling_ra: Reported, not silently exempted. A firing only against continuous-surface priors is not lane drift; a firing against a dot-field prior is a stop.
